messages.subject: Arrow heads inexplicably missing
parts:
Hi everyone,

Has someone remarked this already:

ggplot() + geom_path(aes(x=c(1,2),y=c(2,3)), arrow=arrow())
# works

system("wget http://dl.getdropbox.com/u/1047321/x.csv")
x = read.csv("x.csv")
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y), arrow=arrow())
# no arrows...
# zooming does not reveal anything
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y), arrow=arrow()) +
coord_cartesian(xlim=c(9,10), ylim=c(-11,-9))
# neither does making the arrow heads insanely big
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y), arrow=arrow(angle=45,
length=unit(10,"cm"))) + coord_cartesian(xlim=c(9,10), ylim=c(-11,-9))

# I can't see what's special in this dataset...
names(x)=c("foo", "bar")
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=foo,y=bar), arrow=arrow())

summary(x)
foo bar
Min. :-18.0229 Min. :-14.8568
1st Qu.:-12.5142 1st Qu.: -6.3990
Median : 1.3022 Median : -1.5944
Mean : -0.5638 Mean : -0.1284

llply(x, class)
$foo
[1] "numeric"

[1] "numeric"


This is with latest git commit of ggplot2 (hash 5ad10db3d818704)

Thanks in advance for any help (and sorry to be really pounding on the
list lately, I just happen to be working hard ;) ).

JiHO

messages.author: fc22cb727156ff4f
messages.subject: [SOLVED] Re: Arrow heads inexplicably missing
parts:
No one probably has because this is just me being dumb. I did not
realize that the arrow argument only added an arrow to the *last* bit
of the path, and not to every step.

# the arrow head is actually there but not very visible
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y), arrow=arrow())
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y), arrow=arrow(length=unit(3,"inch")))

# with separation in bits by color for example, I get an arrow head
per step
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y, colour=X), arrow=arrow())
# where X (capital) is the row number

# I don't particularly care about the colour so the key here is to use
grouping so split the path in its sub units. But of course, splitting
it in units of one point does not work:
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y, group=X), arrow=arrow())
# so I just need to trick ggplot and have two successive points in
each group
y = x[-1,]
y$X = y$X-1
x = rbind(x,y)
ggplot(x) + geom_path(aes(x=x,y=y, group=X), arrow=arrow())
# yay!

Sorry to have bothered you all with that.

JiHO
